verdict.rationale: Hyperbrowser documents a public API: an API reference section (e.g. a fetch-a-web-page endpoint), plus Scrape, Crawl and Extract APIs callable in a single request. It also documents starting agent tasks with a single API call and offers official SDKs. Missing for 10: a machine-readable OpenAPI spec (probes at the common paths returned 404), independent or hands-on corroboration of driving the API end to end.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: Fetches a web page and returns the content in various formats (HTML, Markdown, JSON, screenshot, etc.)
The Scrape API allows you to get the data you want from web pages with a single call.
The Crawl API allows you to crawl websites and get data from multiple pages in a single request.
you can start tasks with a single API call and watch them execute live.
Official SDKs for integrating Hyperbrowser into your applications
